concepts.def: Takes shape of container; particles slide
Single element or compound; sharp mp

walkthroughs.body_html:
In solids particles vibrate; in liquids they slide; in gases they move freely.

Energy is needed to overcome forces between particles when changing state.

A pure substance melts at a sharp temperature.

Impurities lower the mp and broaden the range.

This is used to check purity in industry.

Filtration: insoluble solid + liquid.

Crystallisation: dissolved solid from solution.

Distillation: liquids with different bp. Chromatography: coloured substances.

mcqs.q: How does a catalyst speed up a reaction?
options: Different gases occupy completely different volumes proportional to their molar mass.
A catalyst lowers the activation energy of the original reaction pathway.
A catalyst gives extra kinetic energy to the reactant particles.
It provides an alternative reaction pathway with a lower activation energy.

mcqs.q: At room temperature and pressure, what volume does 1 mole of any gas occupy?
options: Heavier gases occupy a smaller volume per mole because their particles are denser.
A catalyst gives extra kinetic energy to the reactant particles.
Different gases occupy completely different volumes proportional to their molar mass.
Approximately 24 dm^3 (24,000 cm^3), regardless of the identity of the gas.

mcqs.q: Why is the 4s orbital filled before the 3d orbital?
options: A catalyst gives extra kinetic energy to the reactant particles.
Because the 4s orbital has a lower energy than 3d when both are empty, so electrons fill it first.
Because d orbitals can only fill after p orbitals in the next shell.
Because the 4s shell is closer to the nucleus than the 3d shell.
